task.description: Re-validate REQ-201 design after rework-1 (CDV-001 fix). Second pass.

result.summary: Second pass — PASS. CDV-001 fully resolved by rework-1: §5 ARMED→FIRED transition now enumerates last_correlation_id write semantics for all four trigger types (per-subject UUID or null for aggregates). All 14 ACs have unambiguous design elements. Both migrations fully specced with per-tenant placement decision and reasoning. All public and named internal function signatures carry @spec with typed inputs and error shapes. Edge-triggered state machine complete (four transitions, initial state, re-arm edge case, upsert mechanism). Alerting/webhook distinction table documented in §0.1. No new application.ex child. No implementation code. Design is clear and sufficient for ELIXIR-DEV to implement without ambiguity on any AC.

non_blocking_observations.observation: Private Poller helper has no formal @spec in the design. Behavior fully described in prose. ELIXIR-DEV should add @spec to the implementation per codebase style. Not a design gate issue.

The design defines the alert_hook_emission_state table schema and last_emitted_key formats (§3.3) but does not specify the read-before-fire algorithm for checking emission state within fire_hooks. The is_armed mechanism (§5) handles all 14 ACs independently. No AC tests per-hook emission deduplication read behavior. ELIXIR-DEV should implement write-on-fire and consult R-Co source (migrations/022_obs06_alerting_state.sql) for any read semantics intent. This is a secondary correctness concern, not a gate-blocking gap.

result.next_action: Route to ELIXIR-DEV (Step 2a). Design gate is CLEARED. rework_count=1.
